item.title: Previous Calls for Papers
item.content:encoded: This section lists previous calls for papers from the Human Resource Management Journal. The calls include topics such as reconsidering careers in post-Covid-19 workplaces, caring for healthcare workers and advancing human resource management research in healthcare contexts, research methodologies that offer insights, and interfacing artificial intelligence technologies with human resource management in new firms.
